critique.evidence: Measured results are demo-ready across all three viewports: FCP 52–76 ms, LCP 548–704 ms, TTFB 1.3–5.8 ms, no browser/request failures, no horizontal overflow, and zero long-frame ratio. CLS is excellent on mobile (0) and desktop (0.0011), though tablet reaches 0.0478. Efficiency is the main limitation: every viewport transfers 1,314,022 bytes including 1,148,898 bytes of JavaScript, while 10 API routes appear to be requested for the 12-screen application. Desktop animation pacing averages 20.73 ms per frame with a 33.4 ms worst frame.
critique.fix: Code-split and lazy-load non-vault screens and their API requests to reduce the 1.15 MB JavaScript payload and 1.31 MB transfer. Reserve dimensions for tablet-shifting content and profile desktop rendering to keep frame times consistently below 16.7 ms.
